titles: Use SIP X-Headers in prompts, actions, and transfers
subtitle: Custom X-* SIP headers on inbound calls become variables you can use in prompts, actions, and transfers.
first_para: Synthflow now accepts arbitrary `X-*` SIP headers on inbound calls. Any custom header your SBC, PBX, or carrier attaches to the SIP INVITE is automatically extracted and made available as a variable throughout the call lifecycle — in prompts, custom actions, and outbound transfer headers. See the full guide: [Use SIP X-Headers in Prompts, Actions & Transfers](/docs/calls/sip-x-headers-in-prompts).

titles: Usage dashboard for subaccounts
subtitle: Review billable minutes and chat usage for your subaccounts in the Usage Dashboard.
first_para: The **Usage Dashboard** is now available for **subaccounts**, so you can review billable minute and chat usage of your subaccounts with a subscription. To learn more about usage, see [Monitoring usage](/usage#monitoring-usage).

It changes how app sections load, making navigation feel more responsive and significantly smoother. You can enable the feature from [Early Access](/early-access) and disable it at any time. If you notice anything unexpected or have feedback, share it with the Synthflow team so we can continue improving the experience before general release.

titles: MCP Connectors
subtitle: Connect agents to external MCP servers so the LLM can use their tools during calls.
first_para: Connect Synthflow agents to external [MCP (Model Context Protocol)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) servers, giving the LLM access to tools it can invoke during calls. Follow the MCP actions guide to connect a server via [UI](/mcp-actions) and via [API](/api-reference/platform-api/mcp-servers/set-workspace-mcp-config), and choose the tools your agent can use.

titles: Choose how action input variables are mapped | Call history now preserves deleted actions
subtitle: Choose where each action input value comes from, and call history keeps actions you later delete.
first_para: When an action needs an input variable, you can now choose how Synthflow should fill the value: collect it from the caller, use an action output, use a system variable, use a pre-call variable, or enter a fixed value. [Action placeholders and mapping](/variables#action-placeholders-and-mapping) explains how input variables work across actions. If an action used during a call is deleted later, the call details will now show a deleted-action placeholder instead of removing it entirely.

subtitle: Faster navigation is on for every workspace, with page loads down to about 0.6 seconds.
first_para: Faster navigation is now available to all workspaces, following its [early-access debut in May](/changelog/2026/5/19). Page transitions that used to take 2 to 3 seconds now load in about 0.6 seconds.

subtitle: Aurora is available to every workspace, and chat logs can be filtered by channel.
first_para: [Aurora](/aurora) is now available to every workspace. It is the AI assistant built into your Synthflow dashboard: describe what you need in natural language and Aurora can build agents, configure actions, manage knowledge bases, analyze calls, and run simulations using your real workspace data. [Chat logs](/logs#chat-logs) now show where each conversation came from. Every chat is tagged as **SMS**, **WhatsApp**, **Widget/API**, or **Test chat**, and you can filter the list by any of those chann

titles: Administration redesign
subtitle: Settings and Agency are combined into one Admin area.
first_para: **Settings** and **Agency** are now unified in a single **Admin** area. The sidebar is grouped into **Workspace Settings**, **Partner**, and **Personal** so you can quickly find workspace billing, subaccount management, branding, and personal account settings in one place.

titles: New user-canceled call status
subtitle: Calls the caller ends within the first second report user-canceled and are not billed.
first_para: When a caller hangs up within the first second, before the agent answers, the call now reports a `user-canceled` [status](/webhooks#call-status-options) with a matching `user_canceled` [end-call reason](/webhooks#end-call-reason-options). Both appear in the [Get a call](/api-reference/n/n) API response and in post-call webhooks. Calls with this status are [not billed](/usage#call-states).

titles: Aurora inbuilt skills | Actions API: per-agent trigger rules for shared actions
subtitle: Aurora adds skills for prompt review and call analysis, and shared actions get per-agent trigger rules.
first_para: [Aurora](/aurora) now includes inbuilt skills for prompt review and call analysis. See [Skills](/aurora#skills) for how to use them. When you attach the same [custom action](/about-custom-actions) to more than one agent, each agent can now have its own **When to use this Action** rule. One shared action, different trigger instructions on each agent. | Endpoint | What's new | | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------

titles: Zoom integration
subtitle: Route Zoom Phone or Zoom Contact Centre calls to Synthflow agents.
first_para: The Zoom integration is now available to everyone. Route your Zoom Phone or Zoom Contact Centre traffic to Synthflow AI agents. Follow our [setup instructions](/zoom) for guidance.

titles: Memory for SMS and WhatsApp | RingCX integration
subtitle: Agents share memory across voice, SMS, and WhatsApp, and RingCX connects over SIP.
first_para: Agents can now use shared [memory](/memory) across voice, SMS, and WhatsApp, helping them continue conversations with relevant history from any channel. You can now connect [RingCX](/sip-with-ringcx) to Synthflow over SIP, running your agent as an Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA) in RingCX voice queues. Route voice queue calls to your agent, pass caller context through Workflow Studio, and hand calls back to the RingCX workflow when the session ends.

titles: Claude Code and Codex connectors
subtitle: Use Synthflow from Claude Code or Codex through the Synthflow MCP server.
first_para: You can now use Synthflow directly from Claude Code or Codex via the **Synthflow MCP server**, giving you access to Synthflow’s core building blocks and operations without leaving your AI workspace. See the [Claude Code](/anthropic) and [Codex](/openai) setup guides for installation steps.

titles: GPT-4o deprecation (non-enterprise accounts) | Web Call replaces Widget testing
subtitle: GPT-4o leaves non-enterprise accounts on July 9, and the Widget test is now Web Call.
first_para: GPT-4o will be removed from the UI and API on July 9, 2026. On that date, any agents still using GPT-4o will be automatically migrated to GPT-5.2. This deprecation only applies to non-enterprise accounts. No action is required. The agent testing interface has been updated, and the Widget test is now Web Call. Functionality stays the same, so you can keep testing your agent straight from the browser.

titles: Custom Caller ID on Call Transfers
subtitle: Show the original caller, a fixed number, or a SIP header value as caller ID on warm transfers.
first_para: Control the caller ID shown on warm transfers: use the original caller’s number, a fixed number, or an inbound SIP header. See [Caller ID on warm transfers](/call-transfers#caller-id) for details.

titles: Voice Widget upgrade available
subtitle: Upgrade Voice Widgets to the new design and faster backend by copying the new embed code.
first_para: Upgrade your [Voice Widgets](/create-an-agent#voice-agent) to the new design and faster real-time backend. Functionality stays the same. * **New widgets** use the upgraded design and backend by default. * **Existing widgets** keep working as before and remain fully editable. To upgrade, copy the new embed code from **Deploy** and add it to your site. This change can't be reversed for that widget. If you keep your current embed, nothing changes.

titles: Egress IP addresses list updated
subtitle: Add six new Global-region outbound IP addresses to your firewall allow-list.
first_para: We added six new outbound IP addresses for the **Global** region. If your network uses a firewall allow-list, add these so platform traffic keeps flowing: * `34.73.34.138` * `34.26.71.171` * `34.148.30.10` * `34.138.149.224` * `34.139.16.79` * `34.23.185.86` See the full list on the [Egress IP addresses](/egress-ip-addresses) page. If you don't restrict inbound traffic, no action is needed.

titles: Live call monitoring
subtitle: Listen in silently to calls in progress from Call logs.
first_para: You can now listen in to a call while it is in progress. Open Call logs, find a call with the in-progress status, and monitor the live conversation. Monitoring is silent, so neither the agent nor the caller can hear you. See [Live call monitoring](/logs#live-call-monitoring) for details.

titles: Sidebar control
subtitle: Set the sidebar to stay collapsed, stay expanded, or expand on hover.
first_para: You can now set the sidebar to collapse, expand, or expand when hovering with the mouse. Find the control in the bottom left corner of the interface.

titles: WebSocket media for websites and apps | Hebrew available
subtitle: WebSocket media is the recommended way to build custom voice integrations, and Hebrew is available.
first_para: WebSocket media is now the recommended way to build custom voice integrations for websites and apps. Instead of using the legacy PCM websocket, start a call from your backend and pass the returned WebSocket URL to your client to stream audio. See the [WebSocket media integration guide](/ws-media-integration) for details. Hebrew joins the list of [available languages](/about-supported-languages) for voice agents.

titles: Rename Aurora conversations
subtitle: Rename Aurora conversations to keep your threads organized.
first_para: You can now rename conversations in [Aurora](/aurora). Give each thread a clear, descriptive name to keep your work organized.

titles: Five9 Handoff action
subtitle: Return calls from your agent to your Five9 workflow with routing context in X-Headers.
first_para: The **Five9 Handoff** action returns a call from your agent to your Five9 workflow, passing routing context as X-Headers on the SIP BYE. The [Five9 integration guide](/sip-with-five9) covers the full AI Agent Connect setup, from onboarding to the data exchanged in each direction. Available on the Enterprise plan. Contact your account manager to activate it.

titles: Improved System Status page
subtitle: The status page moved to a new platform at the same address, and RSS subscribers need to resubscribe.
first_para: The [Synthflow status page](https://status.synthflow.ai/) has moved to a new platform that provides more reliable incident reporting and status updates. The address remains the same, so existing bookmarks and links continue to work. Email subscriptions have been migrated automatically: if you currently receive status updates by email, no action is required. RSS subscriptions cannot be migrated. If you follow the status page by RSS, resubscribe on the [status page](https://status.synthflow.ai/) t

titles: Background audio on running actions
subtitle: Custom actions and MCP tools can play background audio while they run.
first_para: [Custom actions](/about-custom-actions#play-audio-while-the-action-runs) and individual [MCP tools](/mcp-actions#play-audio-while-an-mcp-tool-runs) can now play background audio while they run, giving callers feedback during slower requests.

titles: Stripe-based reselling is ending
subtitle: Move subaccount billing to your own system before custom pricing plans end on September 15, 2026.
first_para: On September 15, 2026, Synthflow will discontinue [custom pricing plans](/set-up-pricing-and-rebilling). This affects partners who have connected their Stripe account and resell minutes to their customers: from that date, Synthflow will no longer bill subaccount minutes through Stripe on your behalf, and subscriptions created through custom pricing plans will stop working. Your own Synthflow subscription is not affected. To keep your customers running without interruption, migrate their subscrip

titles: Official Claude connector and plugin | Phone numbers API: SIP registration
subtitle: Use Synthflow from Claude through the official connector and plugin, and set SIP registration on phone numbers.
first_para: Synthflow's official **Claude** connector and plugin are now live. Use Synthflow's capabilities from Claude, Claude Code, or Cowork in plain language. The **connector** links Claude to your workspace. The **plugin** adds guided call and prompt reviews. See the [guide](/anthropic) to get started. Phone numbers now support outbound SIP registration via the API. Set it when you [import a number](/api-reference/platform-api/phone-numbers/create-custom-number), or [update](/api-reference/platform-api

titles: Analytics across your subaccounts | Pin Aurora conversations
subtitle: Compare analytics across all your subaccounts, and pin Aurora conversations.
first_para: The [analytics dashboard](/collect-analytics#subaccounts-usage) now covers the subaccounts you manage. Set the **All accounts** filter to compare total minutes, calls, and average duration across every subaccount, then select one to open its full dashboard in place. You can now pin conversations in [Aurora](/aurora#conversations). Pinned threads stay at the top of the list, so the work you keep returning to is always in reach.

titles: Phone numbers API: Five9 and RingCX
subtitle: Import Five9 and RingCX numbers through the API, with the SIP domain set for you.
first_para: You can now import [Five9](/sip-with-five9) and [RingCX](/sip-with-ringcx) numbers through the [`POST /custom-numbers`](/api-reference/platform-api/phone-numbers/create-custom-number) endpoint. Synthflow sets their SIP domain automatically.

titles: 8x8 Contact Center integration
subtitle: Route inbound 8x8 Contact Center calls to Synthflow agents.
first_para: You can now route inbound 8x8 Contact Center calls to Synthflow AI agents. Import an 8x8 number in Synthflow to receive a generated 12-digit routing identifier, then use it in your 8x8 Forward to External IVR flow. See the [setup guide](/sip-with-8x8-contact-centre) for instructions.

titles: Advanced Synthflow LLM | Subaccounts API: Reset minutes used
subtitle: Advanced Synthflow LLM handles complex, long prompts, and subaccount minutes can be reset through the API.
first_para: Meet our **Advanced Synthflow LLM**, the strongest reasoning model in the Synthflow family. It handles complex logic and long prompts, so agents with deep branching, detailed conditions, and long instructions stay accurate. Use it when your prompt has outgrown [**Synthflow LLM**](/general-configuration), which stays the default. Subaccount usage counters can now be reset. Set `minutes_used` to `0` on [`PUT /subaccounts/:subaccount_id`](/api-reference/platform-api/subaccounts/update-subaccount) a

titles: Campaigns | Business Hours
subtitle: Call a whole list with Campaigns, and set business hours for each agent.
first_para: Call an entire list with one request. [Campaigns](/batch-calling) dial your recipients over time, as fast as your concurrency allows. Create and control them through the Platform API, pause, resume, or cancel at any point, and watch progress in the portal under **Campaigns**. Available on our Enterprise plans. Reach out to our support team to activate it on your account. Your agents can now keep office hours. Set [business hours](/business-hours) for each day of the week in the agent editor, eva

titles: Filter call logs by phone number
subtitle: Find calls in Call logs by the customer's phone number.
first_para: Call logs can now be filtered by the customer's phone number, so you can find a call when the number is all you have. The filter matches calls to and from that number, and combines with the date, agent, duration, type, and status filters.

titles: Non-enterprise plans now run on Synthflow LLM
subtitle: Non-enterprise accounts run on Synthflow LLM, and GPT models are no longer available on those plans.
first_para: Accounts that are not on an enterprise plan run on **Synthflow LLM**, our model built for voice agents and tuned for real-time phone conversations, with lower latency and more natural turn-taking than a general-purpose model. Third-party models, including the GPT family, are no longer available on these plans. Synthflow LLM is the only option in the **AI Model** selector under [General settings](/general-configuration). Existing agents are migrated automatically, so no action is required in the

titles: Current date and time system variable
subtitle: Use the agent_current_time variable to give agents the current date and time on every call.
first_para: Agents now have access to the current date and time on every call. The new `{agent_current_time}` [system variable](/variables#system-variables) returns it in the agent's [timezone](/general-configuration#timezone) as ISO 8601 with a UTC offset, and works in prompts and [custom actions](/about-custom-actions#variables).

titles: Improvements to speech recognition
subtitle: Choose Faster for lower latency or High Accuracy to capture numbers reliably.
first_para: The [Speech Recognition](/additional-settings#speech-recognition) setting now gives a clearer trade-off between speed and precision. Choose **Faster** for the lowest latency, or **High Accuracy** when the agent needs to capture numbers reliably, such as phone numbers, order IDs, and account references. High Accuracy costs some latency in exchange. You set it under **Additional Settings** in the [agent editor](/the-agent-editor).

titles: Voice Widgets move to the new design
subtitle: Every remaining Voice Widget moves to the new design on September 16, with no action required.
first_para: On **September 16, 2026**, every remaining [Voice Widget](/create-an-agent#voice-agent) moves to the [upgraded design](/changelog/2026/6/30) and faster real-time backend. No action is required: the embed already on your site keeps working. The [Voice Widget migration guide](/widget-migration-guide) explains what changes and how to test the new embed before then.

titles: Official ChatGPT plugin
subtitle: Build and manage voice agents from ChatGPT with the official Synthflow plugin.
first_para: Synthflow's official **ChatGPT** [plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_templated_apps_6a8d61e3eb088191a6116aa249be72cd?q=synthflow) is now live. Build and manage voice agents from a conversation in ChatGPT, without leaving the chat. See the [guide](/openai) to get started.

titles: Use the new Synthflow app
subtitle: Turn on the new Synthflow app at app.synthflow.ai from Early Access.
first_para: The new Synthflow app runs at `app.synthflow.ai`, with faster page loads and more responsive navigation. Turn it on for your workspace from [Early Access](/early-access). The [guide](/new-synthflow-app) covers what changes and the current known issues.

titles: Time to human on warm transfers | New transfer outcome states | Action execution timeline in webhooks
subtitle: Warm transfers record when a person answered, report more outcome states, and list every attempt in webhooks.
first_para: Warm transfers that connect now record `human_connected_at`, the moment the caller actually reached a person, not just when the transfer started. See [transfer timestamps](/transfer-outcome-states#transfer-timestamps). A transfer that reaches a phone menu, a voicemail greeting, or a busy line now reports that instead of a generic timeout. If you match on outcome state, add the values from the full list of [transfer outcome states](/call-transfers#transfer-outcome-states). A transfer that retried

titles: Auto-overage for subaccounts | 200 voices for Synthflow TTS
subtitle: Let subaccounts call past their included minutes, and choose from 200 Synthflow TTS voices.
first_para: Parent accounts now control whether a subaccount can call past its included minutes. Turn on [Auto-overage](/limits-and-capabilities#auto-overage) and the extra minutes are billed to your account at your per-minute rate. [Synthflow TTS](/voice-configuration#synthflow-tts) now offers 200 voices instead of 12, so you can match a voice to your brand instead of settling for the closest fit. Filter the **Voice** selector by accent, gender, or language, and play a preview before you assign one. Voices

titles: Synthflow TTS for multilingual agents | Custom action response time | Call quality metrics on every call
subtitle: Synthflow TTS works for multilingual agents, and call details show action response times and call quality.
first_para: Agents set to **Multilingual** can now use [Synthflow TTS](/voice-configuration#synthflow-tts) as their voice model or fallback. One voice covers the whole conversation, including when the caller switches language mid-call. [Call details](/logs#call-logs) now shows the response time of every custom action. Open a call, check the **Actions** tab, and find the slow endpoint behind a long silence. The **Telephony** tab now reports [call quality](/sip-call-ladder#call-quality) for every call, so you

titles: Emails
subtitle: Send an email after each call with a Post-Call Email action.
first_para: Your agent can now send an email once the call ends. Attach a [Post-Call Email](/post-call-email) action to any agent and pick who should receive it.

titles: Run simulations from the agent editor
subtitle: Create and run test suites without leaving the agent editor.
first_para: You can now create and run [test suites](/simulations) without leaving the agent editor. Change a prompt, rerun the suite, and see what passed or failed right next to the agent.

titles: Prompt Reuse metric
subtitle: Prompt Reuse in Analytics shows how much of its prompt an agent reuses, which lowers latency.
first_para: **Prompt Reuse** is a new metric in [Analytics](/collect-analytics) that shows the health of your agent's prompt. It measures how much of the prompt the AI model reused instead of reading it again. Use it to understand why some agents respond faster than others: the more of its prompt an agent reuses, the lower its latency in the call. Learn more about [Prompt Reuse](/collect-analytics#prompt-reuse).

titles: Extended list of transfer failure reasons
subtitle: Failed transfers now report nine specific failure reasons instead of a generic one.
first_para: Failed transfers now report more specific failure reasons: * `number_not_found` * `number_incomplete` * `destination_unavailable` * `rejected_by_destination` * `transfer_blocked_by_carrier` * `carrier_unavailable` * `routing_loop` * `media_negotiation_failed` * `transfer_method_unsupported` Find every state, reason, and SIP code in the [transfer outcome states reference](/transfer-outcome-states).

titles: Improved performance in Logs search
subtitle: Call logs and webhook logs search faster, with exact matches on phone numbers and IDs.
first_para: Searching your logs is now much faster, including in high-volume workspaces. * **Call logs:** The **Phone Number** filter now only finds exact matches, so results load instantly. Enter the full number, including the country code. * **Webhook logs:** Search by a full Call ID, webhook log ID, or action ID for instant results.

titles: Actions API: Readable names | Agents API: Updated Get an agent response
subtitle: Action names keep the text you type, and Get an agent returns more fields.
first_para: Names of call transfer, post-call SMS, in-call SMS, and WhatsApp actions are now saved exactly as you type them, up to 64 characters, through both the [Actions API](/api-reference/platform-api/actions/create-action) and the app. The [Get an agent](/api-reference/platform-api/agents/get-assistant) response now includes these fields: * `knowledge_base_id` * `agent.greeting_message_mode` * `agent.greeting_message_human_talk_timeout` * `agent.suppression_level` * `agent.redact_pii` * `agent.voice_st

titles: The new Synthflow app is coming to everyone
subtitle: Every workspace moves to the new Synthflow app on October 14, 2026, with no action required.
first_para: On **October 14, 2026**, every workspace moves to the faster [new Synthflow app](/new-synthflow-app) at `app.synthflow.ai`. Your data and integrations will be right where you left them, so **no action is required**. This does not apply to [custom domains](/custom-domain). Check out the [guide](/new-synthflow-app) to see what changes and what remains.

titles: Transfer results in Call logs | SIP ladder for warm transfers
subtitle: See transfer results in Call logs, and follow each warm transfer attempt in the SIP ladder.
first_para: Check whether [transfers](/call-transfers) connected without opening the call. Select the arrow in the **Transfers** column to see every attempt and its result. The [SIP ladder](/sip-call-ladder#warm-transfers) now shows every warm transfer attempt, not only the original call, so you can follow each transfer's SIP signaling message by message, with timestamps.

titles: ElevenLabs v4 and v4 Turbo | Every action run in the Calls API | Voice accent in GET /voices
subtitle: Pick ElevenLabs v4 or v4 Turbo as your voice model, get every action run in the Calls API, and filter voices by accent.
first_para: You can now pick **ElevenLabs v4** or **ElevenLabs v4 Turbo** as your [voice model](/voice-configuration#elevenlabs-v4-and-v4-turbo). Both support [audio tags](/voice-configuration#audio-tags), the same as V3. In the API, set `voice_synthesizer` to `eleven_v4` or `eleven_v4_turbo`. When a call ran the same action more than once (such as knowledge base lookups or custom actions), the Calls API returned only the last run. Add `include_all_actions=true` to [Get a call](/api-reference/platform-api/c

titles: Redesigned call Overview tab
subtitle: See why a call ended, whether it reached voicemail, and how each transfer went, right on the call.
first_para: The post-call webhook was one place to see why a call ended or whether it reached voicemail. The **Overview** tab in [Call logs](/logs#call-logs) now shows it on the call itself: * The summary, end reason, disconnect reason, and voicemail result, side by side. Hover over a field to see what it means. * **Transfer**: each attempt, its outcome, and how far into the call it started, so you no longer search the transcript to see if a transfer worked. * **Call**, **Agent**, **Contact**, and **Technic

titles: GPT-6 Luna | Business hours through the API | Custom action results through the API
subtitle: Run your agents on OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna, set business hours through the API, and pick custom action results without Initialize.
first_para: You can now run your agents on OpenAI's GPT-6. Pick **GPT-6-Luna** in the [AI Model selector](/general-configuration), or set `llm` to `gpt-6-luna` when you [create](/api-reference/platform-api/agents/create-assistant) or [update](/api-reference/platform-api/agents/update-assistant) an agent. An agent's [business hours](/business-hours) could only be set in the app. You can now set them through the API as well. When you [create](/api-reference/platform-api/agents/create-assistant) or [update](/a

titles: Redesigned sidebar | Read a full knowledge base source via API | Send emails via API
subtitle: A sidebar organized around BELL with the changelog built in, plus full knowledge base sources and post-call email actions in the API.
first_para: Every page in the sidebar now sits under the step of the [BELL framework](/getting-started#the-bell-framework) it belongs to. **Help** and **Changelog** have moved to the bottom of the sidebar. Open **Changelog** to see what's new without leaving the app. Listing a knowledge base's sources returns only the first 200 characters of each text source, and no content for other types. To read one source in full, use [Get a knowledge base source](/api-reference/platform-api/knowledge-bases/get-knowledg

titles: See every variable on a call | Manage phone book entries via API
subtitle: A new Variables tab in call logs shows the value of every variable a call used, and the API now lists and updates phone book entries.
first_para: If you've been piecing together what a call sent to your actions, open the new **Variables** tab in [Call logs](/logs#call-logs). It shows the value each variable had on that call: * [System, pre-call, and collected variables](/variables), and inbound SIP headers * Every action's inputs and outputs, including transfer SIP headers Once you added numbers to a phone book through the API, you could not read them back. You can now [list a phone book's entries](/api-reference/platform-api/phone-books/

titles: Filter call logs by action | Set action input sources via API | Advanced transfer settings via API
subtitle: Find every call that ran a specific action, and set action inputs and advanced transfer settings via API.
first_para: To check how an action performed, you had to open calls one by one. In [Call logs](/logs#action-filter), the **Action** filter now shows only the calls that ran the action you pick. Starting from the action works too: on the **Actions** page, open an action's menu and select **View Call Logs** to see its calls. Through the API, [List calls](/api-reference/platform-api/calls/list-calls) filters by action too. Actions attached to an agent through the API asked the caller for every input, even valu

titles: Manage subaccounts from Settings
subtitle: The sidebar no longer has an Agency button. Subaccounts and other agency tools now live under Settings.
first_para: We redesigned the main sidebar to cut clutter and keep it focused on the pages you use every day. As part of that change, the **Agency** button is gone and everything it opened now lives in **Settings**. To manage your [subaccounts](/subaccounts), select **Settings**, then **Subaccounts**.

titles: Webhook signatures for subaccounts
subtitle: Share your workspace's webhook secret key so subaccounts sign their webhooks too.
first_para: Subaccount webhooks went out unsigned, so you couldn't confirm they came from Synthflow. You can now [share your workspace's secret key with your subaccounts](/security#subaccounts), so their webhooks carry the same `HTTP_SYNTHFLOW_SIGNATURE` header you already validate.
